summary: This report recommends that City Council approve the alterations proposed for the properties at 15 Duncan Street and 158 Pearl Street in accordance with Section 33 of the Ontario Heritage Act to allow for the construction of a 60-storey tower on the properties and per the settlement offer submitted to the City in conjunction with and appeal to the Ontario Municipal Board, now the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT) and the subsequent mediation of the application for a Zoning By-law Amendment. This report also recommends that City Council state its intention to designate 15 Duncan Street and 158 Pearl Street under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act and give authority to enter into a Heritage Easement Agreement for these properties.
